# Sanitized Langfuse API v2 conformance fixture

This fixture is fully synthetic. Its field names, value types, token-detail
keys, and missing-parent topology mirror sanitized production export shapes,
but every identifier, timestamp, name, payload, and metadata value is canned.
It contains no customer data.

The two source traces share one recurring `traceName`: a known-good execution
and a structural regression with a new repeated tool path and higher token use.
